messages:
maria (eng-platform): Heads-up — customer reported CSV export from the Insights dashboard including rows from other workspaces. repro attached, minimal steps.
axel (eng-platform): I can reproduce locally. export SQL is using saved_view.query but the saved_view.scope is null for some legacy views so WHERE workspace_id is dropped :/ 
maria (eng-platform): yikes. only impacts saved views created before the scope migration (pre-2023). no rollout yet AFAIK.
axel (eng-platform): quick snippet from the exporter: `const base = view.query; const final = view.scope ? base + ` WHERE workspace_id=${w}` : base;` — so null scope => missing filter.
sam (eng-sre): do we have telemetry showing how many exports ran last 7d with saved_view.scope = null? could be a lot if many orgs never re-saved views.
jia (product): @maria how bad customer impact? any PII leaked or just project names/rows? we need priority.
maria (eng-platform): flagged by a customer — some project rows with team names (non-sensitive) but definitely cross-tenant. customer asked for root cause and mitigation.
oliver (security): need facts. if any PII, treat as incident. For now assume sensitive until we confirm. @sam can you gather a short list of affected org ids and rows (sanitized) and retention policy status?
sam (eng-sre): on it. running query against export logs and S3 prefixes, will DM findings. setting high priority.
axel (eng-platform): short-term mitigation: add guard in exporter to reject exports where saved_view.scope == null unless caller is org-admin and explicit confirm flag set. pushing a patch to staging.
karen (devex): we should also add a Console banner + quick doc to advise users to re-save views to adopt new scope. small UX nudge.
maria (eng-platform): agreed. axel, can you open a canary PR + add unit test for exported SQL having `workspace_id` param? Make the change defensive.
axel (eng-platform): PR opened -> https://git.local/r/redwood/exporter/pulls/3125 ; test added. patch includes fallback: treat null scope as "isolation required" by default.
deploy-bot: CI passed, starting canary deploy to staging (tag: exporter-fix-3125)
sam (eng-sre): canary running on 10% of traffic in staging. monitoring export error rate and latency.
oliver (security): good. once canary is clean, we should do an emergency config rollout to prod with a feature flag defaulting to ON for safety.
jia (product): customers hit? let's prepare a short post-mortem template and outreach note for affected customers. keep wording calm.
maria (eng-platform): outreach note draft: "We found an exporter edge-case affecting legacy saved views where workspace scoping could be omitted; we patched the exporter and are verifying no PII exposure. We're proactively re-running exports and will follow up." please edit.
axel (eng-platform): also adding a cron job to detect saved_view.scope == null and auto-tag them for migration (non-destructive). will follow up with a migration RFC.
sam (eng-sre): found 42 exports last 30d that look cross-tenant; none include email columns from initial scan, but will continue deeper check. reporting in #incidents shortly.
oliver (security): thanks. keep me looped. if any confirmed sensitive leak we trigger full incident process.
karen (devex): I'll add a tooltip in the saved-views editor saying "legacy view — click to upgrade scope". small PR incoming.
maria (eng-platform): nice. next steps: finish canary -> prod rollout + run detection job -> customer outreach -> migration plan. assigning owners in the PR.
axel (eng-platform): noted. tagging @sam for prod deploy window. :thumbsup:
sam (eng-sre): planning prod deploy in 2h if canary stable. will coordinate with oncall.
maria (eng-platform): thanks team. continuing in thread for updates.
